artworks.title: The Cult of Ceres
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in an outdoor setting, surrounded by three men. The woman has braided hair adorned with plant stalks, and is holding a basket and a sickle. The men are kneeling or crouching, dressed in simple clothing and holding farming tools. The background features fields, workers, and mountains under a cloudy sky with a bright sun.

artworks.title: The Cult of Venus
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows a woman on the left holding a flaming heart, with a winged cherub next to her. On the right, a man kneels next to a woman who is holding a flower. Other figures are partially visible in the background. The setting includes a landscape and a chariot pulled by two horses in the sky. The scene is engraved with fine lines and detailed.

artworks.title: The Cult of Bacchus
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group featuring a central allegorical figure. The scene depicts a classical theme with a central nude figure adorned with drapery and an elaborate headpiece of grapevines and leaves, suggestive of a mythical or god-like entity possibly related to wine or harvest, holding grapes. Around are other figures, likely peasants or followers, appearing to admire or supplicate the central figure. The setting suggests a pastoral landscape with rolling hills and distant structures. The figures are portrayed in intricate detail, highlighting exaggerated expressions and dynamic poses typical of the Baroque style. The composition suggests a narrative moment, with attention to the interplay between the figures and the background landscape.

artworks.title: Fall of the Damned
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff, after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a print depicting angels, humans, and beasts tangled together in a battle. At the top, winged angles are depicted soaring downward from the clouds, some holding long spears, arrows, or round shields. Below them, nude humans are entangled with creatures that have human bodies with the faces of animals, including pointed ears and horns. The faces of the humans are contorted in distress, with open mouths and wide eyes, while the creatures are smiling. Some of the people also appear to be wrapped in long ropes or snakes. The composition is tightly packed with muscular bodies, and billowing clouds frame the scene. At the bottom of the print are several lines of text.

artworks.title: Alexander the Great Seated in Justice
artworks.artist: Willem Swanenburgh, after Joachim Anthonisz Wtewael
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 29.9 x 37 cm (11 3/4 x 14 9/16 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: The image shows a group scene with multiple full-bodied figures arranged around a central seated figure on a raised platform with a decorative curtain backdrop. The central figure is a bearded, bare-chested man holding a staff. Other figures are engaged in conversation or debate, dressed in classical tunics and robes with various hats. Columns and steps are in the background, along with a natural landscape with trees and mountains in the distance.

artworks.title: Allegory of Justice
artworks.artist: Willem Swanenburgh, after Joachim Anthonisz Wtewael
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a formal scene within a grand architectural setting. The composition includes numerous figures dressed in period clothing, set amidst columns and steps. In the background, flags can be seen. Soft shading and cross-hatching techniques are used for depth and contrast. Construction work is depicted in the distance on the right side. The drawing showcases detailed costumes, architecture, and group dynamics.

artworks.title: Beheading of the Roman Judge Papinian
artworks.artist: Willem Swanenburgh, after Joachim Anthonisz Wtewael
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 29 x 38.7 cm (11 7/16 x 15 1/4 in.) (trimmed within plate mark)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of four figures in the foreground. Two figures hold weapons: an axe and a spear. One figure holds a severed head. The setting is an architectural interior with columns and arches. In the background, another scene is shown. The line work and shading create depth and drama. The figures are detailed with emotive expressions and muscular physiques.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.artist: Willem Swanenburgh, after Joachim Anthonisz Wtewael
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a biblical scene with dynamic composition in a forested landscape. The central figure carries a large wooden cross while others guide or restrain them with tools and weapons. Additional figures are seen in the background. The artwork includes intricate linework, shading, and use of light and shadow to add depth and drama.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment
artworks.artist: Willem Swanenburgh, after Joachim Anthonisz Wtewael
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring numerous figures in a supernatural setting. The artwork shows a complex composition of figures arranged across what appears to be a celestial gathering or judgment. The scene is divided into several tiers of action, with clouds supporting various characters in the sky. Ethereal beings and other figures are interacting, surrounded by dramatic clouds and symbols like a cross and a weighing scale. The lower section depicts figures in dynamic poses, with some ascending upwards. The figures are detailed, showing motion, emotion, and varying degrees of divine or mortal characteristics. The artwork uses chiaroscuro to create depth and theatrical lighting.

artworks.title: Suzannah before Daniel
artworks.artist: Willem Swanenburgh, after Joachim Anthonisz Wtewael
artworks.dimensions: plate: 27.6 x 39.1 cm (10 7/8 x 15 3/8 in.) (trimmed within platemark at bottom)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a classical architectural setting. It depicts a gathering of individuals dressed in elaborate Renaissance or Baroque attire among grand columns and arcades. The central focus is a woman surrounded by others, with a sense of tension depicted in their postures and expressions. The background includes detailed architectural elements like arches, windows, and a distant building with classical features. The shading and linework accentuate the contrasts and depth in the composition, highlighting drama and narrative storytelling characteristic of the Baroque era.

artworks.title: Profile of an Old Man with a Hat
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of a person's face in profile, with only a portion of the head and shoulder visible. The person's head is tilted slightly backward, with the chin pointing upward. The facial features are depicted with a detailed texture, emphasizing a prominent nose and beard. The individual is wearing a large, textured top hat that obscures the top part of the head and the eyes. The clothing includes a garment with a visible seam and some textured detail around the collar area. The drawing is composed of fine lines and shading, giving texture and depth to the person's features. The background consists of more fine, stippled lines, creating an abstract, textured effect without distinct shapes or objects.

artworks.title: Aiolos, Personification of Wind
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a person standing on a large shell in the water. Their back faces the viewer as they hold a flowing fabric. The person has curly hair, a muscular build, and is minimally clothed with draped fabric. The intricate frame around them contains decorative designs. Faint outlines of structures and ships are in the background, suggesting a coastal setting. The border includes musical instruments, floral motifs, and faces.

artworks.title: The Bodies of Saints Peter and Paul
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two draped, reclining figures in an outdoor setting with a rocky or architectural structure. Above them is a winged figure. The landscape includes trees and a textured sky. The composition features detailed etching.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a group of figures in an ancient setting. The scene includes a central character on a table surrounded by other figures. In the background, there is a statue of a draped figure and an ancient city backdrop. A group of individuals are seated to the left, some in elaborate attire. The drawing is detailed with shading and texture, creating a dramatic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Don Quichote
artworks.medium: woodcut printed in black and gray (?) on laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: This image features bold, intersecting lines and shapes. In the center, there are angular forms resembling two figures mounted on horses. The background is filled with jagged patterns and linear textures.

artworks.title: Porte d'Orleans
artworks.description: The image shows intersecting lines and shapes forming an abstract scene. Circular and linear patterns create a sense of chaos. The composition suggests a street scene with figures, a trolley, and vehicles. Some recognizable objects are a sign with "Porte d'Orleans." The dense lines give the impression of a bustling city intersection.

artworks.title: Vintemille
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of a densely built hillside town. The horizon is set high, with the top of the hill housing a prominent spire, likely a church, which stands out in the composition. The town is a complex network of rectangular structures. The style is loose and sketch-like, with thin, swirling lines creating a sense of movement. The color palette is monochromatic, using gray and black on a cream background. Detailed buildings and winding roads close to us lead into the town, highlighting the layered architecture stretching into the distance. In the upper right corner, there is a swirling, dark circle.

artworks.title: Qual (Torment)
artworks.medium: color lithograph in black, violet, pink, and yellow, on japan paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals in a stylized artwork. The person on the right lies reclined facing forward, with their arm extended and bent. They have defined facial features, wide eyes, and a furrowed brow. The person on the left is shown in profile with closed eyes. Both individuals have stylized facial features and dark, tousled hair, covered by a purple and gray blanket. The background is abstract with dark tones, creating a dramatic appearance.

artworks.title: A Girl on Her Deathbed with a Crown of Flowers
artworks.medium: black chalk and white chalk on brown paper, in original green leather folding frame
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 26.2 x 27 cm (10 5/16 x 10 5/8 in.) (measured through glass)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person from the shoulders up, lying in a reclining position. The person's head is tilted back, eyes closed, lips gently closed. They have long hair in two braids, a simple garment with a ruffled collar, and a floral wreath on their head. The background is a shaded surface, suggesting a soft pillow or cushion. The image is drawn with visible pencil and shading techniques.

artworks.title: Ruins of the Oybin Monastery in Winter
artworks.description: The image shows an arched stone entryway leading into an ancient, roofless structure with Gothic architectural features. Three tall, arched windows reveal the sky, tall pine trees, and part of a crumbling stone wall. Brushstrokes capture stone texture and sky softness. The color palette includes muted earth tones and hints of blue and white in the sky. Dark birds move across the stone floor, complementing the play of light and shadow. Snow accents the upper stone surfaces, indicating a cold season.

artworks.title: A Mounted Cavalry Officer Seen from Behind
artworks.medium: oil paint on brown oiled paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the full back view of a person sitting on a horse. The person is wearing a black military-style uniform with red details, including a red collar and red cuffs. They have a high black helmet adorned with a white plume. The person is positioned in a side-saddle manner, leaning slightly to the left, with their left hand holding the reins or bridle near the horse's neck. They are carrying crossed white belts across their back, a sheathed sword attached to the left side of their waist, and additional silver-toned and red accessories strapped across their chest and waist. The background is plain and solid brown.

artworks.title: Il Liceo della Pittura
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a grand architectural and allegorical scene. The architectural backdrop includes classical arches and columns with ornate decorations and relief sculptures. In the foreground, groups of draped figures engage in various activities such as studying or discussing with scrolls and manuscripts. The composition is structured with a central focal point of a large statue or figure. Various elements suggest a theme of learning, art, or philosophy, indicated by inscriptions and symbols in the design. The image is characterized by intricate line work and fine details typical of classical or neoclassical art.

artworks.title: Pont des Arts
artworks.creditLine: Fund in Honor of Christopher With
artworks.description: The image depicts a nighttime cityscape with buildings and a domed structure against the horizon. A full moon shines in the sky off-center to the left, illuminating the scene. The artwork features intricate crosshatched brushstrokes creating texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, with black and white tones. The moon's reflection on the water connects the foreground to the skyline.

artworks.title: Dans un Parc
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient archway partially hidden by a dense grove of trees. Tall trees with one large central tree and outspread branches dominate the scene. The horizon is obscured by the thick foliage. The technique appears to be etching, evident in the intricate lines depicting the trees and archway. The color scheme is monochromatic in varying shades of black and sepia. Near the bottom, there is a shadowy patch on the ground, possibly indicating reflective water. The archway is surrounded by trees, conveying a secluded atmosphere. In the background, the sky is illustrated with light, fine lines, enhancing the scene's contrast and ethereal feel.
